syncs.description: Make the connected customer's Login with Amazon profile available as a replicated customer-profile record. Each connection exposes only its authorized customer, not an Amazon customer directory. Requires any one of profile:user_id, postal_code, or profile.
syncs.name: sync-customer-profiles

id.description: Opaque Amazon user_id for the connected customer, scoped to the Login with Amazon company rather than globally across companies.

name.description: Customer name shared by Amazon; omitted when not returned under the granted permissions.

email.description: Customer's registered Amazon email address as returned, without case normalization or inferred verification status; omitted when not shared.

postalCode.description: Primary shipping address zip or postal code when shared; preserve leading zeros, spaces, and letter case. Omitted when not returned.

CustomerProfiles.description: The connected customer's Login with Amazon profile, limited to data shared under the granted permissions.

functions.name: get-customer-profile
functions.description: Retrieve the connected Amazon customer's identifier and the profile information shared through the connection's granted scopes.

FunctionInput_amazon_getcustomerprofile.description: Look up the connected Amazon customer without any input parameters.

id.description: Opaque Amazon user_id for the connected customer. Its identity scope is the Login with Amazon company; do not treat it as a universal cross-company identifier.

name.description: Customer name as shared by Amazon. Omitted when not returned under the granted permissions.

email.description: Email address registered with Amazon as returned by the provider. Omitted when not shared; no normalization or inferred verification status.

postalCode.description: Zip or postal code from the customer's primary shipping address when shared. Preserve leading zeros, spaces, and letter case. Omitted when not returned.

FunctionOutput_amazon_getcustomerprofile.description: The connected Amazon customer identifier and the profile fields shared under the granted permissions.

tags.instructions: Use for an on-demand lookup of the connected customer. No customer identifier is needed. The connection's permissions determine whether name, email, and postal code are returned; missing fields are not empty values. This cannot look up other Amazon customers. Use `verify-access-token` instead to check an externally supplied token's audience.
